claims.text: The finance committee approved the budget transfer at approximately 03:00 on 10 August 2026.
claims.note: Ynet and Mako are separately owned, so this clears the two-independent-sources bar.

claims.text: Committee members were sent a cancellation notice roughly one hour before the sitting reconvened.
claims.note: Only three members' accounts, all via one outlet. The notice itself has not been published. The cartoon may depict the dispute; it may not assert the timing as fact.

claims.text: The chair deliberately reconvened the sitting to exclude opposing members.
claims.note: This is an inference about motive that no source establishes. STRIPPED — it may not appear in any concept, explicitly or by implication.

stripped_claims: The chair deliberately reconvened the sitting to exclude opposing members.

falsification_attempts.attempted: Searched for a committee statement, correction or clarification issued after the initial reports that would contradict the 03:00 timing.
falsification_attempts.note: No denial or correction found; the timing is not in dispute in any source.

falsification_attempts.attempted: Checked whether the quoted member complaint was truncated in a way that reverses its meaning.
falsification_attempts.note: The quote appears in the same form in both the headline and the body.

falsification_attempts.attempted: Tried to establish intent behind the reconvening from any on-record source.
falsification_attempts.note: No source supports an intent claim. This is why it is stripped rather than softened.

claims.text: Three of five renderings in the 2026 housing presentation previously appeared in a 2019 ministry announcement.
claims.note: Independently owned, and the claim is checkable by direct comparison of two published documents.

claims.text: The ministry has not disputed the identification.

falsification_attempts.attempted: Looked for a ministry response, denial or explanation published after the initial reports.
falsification_attempts.note: None found in the 48 hours following publication.

falsification_attempts.attempted: Checked whether the 2019 renderings were generic stock imagery, which would make reuse unremarkable.
falsification_attempts.note: Provenance of the original images could not be established. The cartoon should stay on 'reused', not on 'faked'.
